mapper.update: UPDATE agent_mandate_query_receipts SET queried_at=#{queriedAt},expires_at=#{expiresAt},snapshot_json=#{snapshotJson},snapshot_hash=#{snapshotHash} WHERE action_id=#{actionId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND invalidated=FALSE AND queried_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.action_id,r.user_id,r.conversation_id,r.bound_version,r.invalidated,r.queried_at,r.expires_at,r.snapshot_json,r.snapshot_hash FROM agent_mandate_query_receipts r WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND r.invalidated=FALSE AND r.queried_at IS NOT NULL AND r.expires_at>#{now} ORDER BY r.queried_at DESC,r.action_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_mandate_query_receipts SET invalidated=TRUE WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND invalidated=FALSE
UPDATE agent_mandate_query_receipts SET invalidated=TRUE WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND invalidated=FALSE
